card.name: Inside longer words, mid-spelling
card.fires_on: Responds to a middle piece of a longer word that is split into parts, such as 'TR' in IN-TR-AVENOUS, 'als' in Annals, or 'al' in lenalidomide. The word is unfinished at that point.

modes.label: Capitalised route words
modes.description: The 'TR' piece inside INTRATHECAL, INTRAVENOUS or INTRAMUSCULAR written in capitals.

modes.label: Journal name Annals
modes.description: The 'als' piece after Ann in the title Annals of a journal.
